ValidationRule.description: Anniversary Date only when Marital Status is Married, not in the future and after the Date of Birth - the same rules the New Lead screen, Upload Leads and the website API apply, enforced here for Edit, inline edit and data loads too.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Anniversary_Date__c)), OR( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Marital_Status__c, "Married")), Anniversary_Date__c > TODAY(), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Date_of_Birth__c)), Anniversary_Date__c <= Date_of_Birth__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Anniversary Date can only be given when Marital Status is Married, must be after the Date of Birth and cannot be in the future.
